people.name: Barzillai
people.line: A Gileadite who provided for David during Absalom's rebellion.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: The king said to Barzillai, “Come over with me, and I will sustain you with me in Jerusalem.”
translations.bsb: The king said to Barzillai, “Cross over with me, and I will provide for you at my side in Jerusalem.”
translations.kjv: And the king said unto Barzillai, Come thou over with me, and I will feed thee with me in Jerusalem.
translations.asv: And the king said unto Barzillai, Come thou over with me, and I will sustain thee with me in Jerusalem.
